name: STEP
aliases: Saw palmetto for Treatment of Enlarged Prostates
question: Does saw palmetto extract improve urinary symptoms or peak urinary flow more than placebo in men with moderate-to-severe BPH symptoms?

arms.label: Saw palmetto extract 160 mg twice daily

design.population: 225 men older than 49 years with moderate-to-severe BPH symptoms, AUASI at least 8, and peak urinary flow below 15 mL/s.
design.description: Single-center, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized superiority trial
design.locator: Bent 2006, journal pp 557-560, Methods and Figure 1

verdictNote: Neither prespecified primary measure differed significantly from placebo at one year.
takeaway: Saw palmetto extract 160 mg twice daily did not improve AUASI symptom scores or peak urinary flow more than placebo after one year in men with moderate-to-severe BPH symptoms.

reports.label: One-year efficacy report
reports.citation: Bent S, Kane C, Shinohara K, et al. "Saw Palmetto for Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia." *N Engl J Med.* 2006;354(6):557-566. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa053085

results.measure: Mean difference in 12-month AUASI score change, saw palmetto minus placebo
results.note: Two-sided superiority alpha was 0.04; lower scores indicate fewer symptoms. The likelihood-ratio test of the full response curves gave P=0.73. At month 12, 107/112 versus 109/113 had AUASI observations; the mixed model included all available data under intention to treat.
results.locator: Full text, Statistical Analysis, pp 559-560; Figure 2 and Table 2, p 562

results.measure: Mean difference in 12-month peak-flow change, saw palmetto minus placebo (mL/s)
results.note: Two-sided superiority alpha was 0.04. The likelihood-ratio test of the full response curves gave P=0.65. At month 12, 101/112 versus 105/113 had peak-flow observations; the mixed model included all available data under intention to treat.
results.locator: Full text, Statistical Analysis, pp 559-560; Table 2, p 562; Figure 3 and Results, p 563

results.measure: Mean difference in 12-month postvoid-residual change, saw palmetto minus placebo (mL)
Mean difference in 12-month prostate-volume change, saw palmetto minus placebo (mL)
Mean difference in 12-month BPH Impact Index change, saw palmetto minus placebo

harms.label: Participants with at least one serious adverse event
harms.locator: Full text, Table 3 and Results, p 563
harms.note: There were 8 versus 18 serious events; the participant-level comparison was not significant (P=0.31).

delivery.label: Study extract and placebo
delivery.value: One-batch Indena carbon-dioxide extract in soft gelatin capsules, 160 mg twice daily; matched placebo contained polyethylene glycol-400.

delivery.label: Completion and adherence
delivery.value: 107/112 (95.5%) saw palmetto and 109/113 (96.5%) placebo participants completed follow-up, 216/225 (96.0%) overall; 92% of study medication was consumed by capsule count, with no significant between-group adherence difference.
delivery.locator: Full text, Figure 1, p 560; Results, p 561

delivery.label: Extract composition
delivery.value: The one-batch carbon-dioxide extract contained 92.1% total fatty acids before study initiation and 90.7% total fatty acids and 0.33% total sterols at the midpoint assay.
